name: Occupational Therapy (BS)
intro: The undergraduate curriculum leads to the Bachelor of Science with a major in Occupational Therapy. Incoming freshmen may apply to the bachelor’s to doctorate program in occupational therapy. The program is part of an accelerated Bachelor’s to Doctorate (BS-OTD) pathway that integrates undergraduate and graduate coursework. Eligible USC freshmen and sophomores may apply to change their major to the program. Students

notes: With a minimum GPA of 3.0 (pass/fail or grades below a C are not accepted)
From an accredited junior college, four-year college or university
Either in a classroom setting or online; however, the anatomy laboratory must be completed in a classroom setting (refer to Course Work Taken Elsewhere)
For a total of three semester units each (with the exception of medical terminology, which may be certificate, credit/no credit, 1 or 2 units)
Students who wish to transfer credit for courses taken at another institution must gain university approval.
